A complete but broken finger ring of Roman date. The finger ring has a flat rectangular cross section with an expanded ovate bezel. The bezel has a deep groove running horizontally separating an inscription in two lines, one above the other below the line. The inscription is very shallow and worn though the upper text appears to read AVI and the lower VILA or VICA. The metal has a mid green patina and is worn. The finger ring is 20.7mm long, 8.5mm wide, 1mm thick and weighs 1.8g
